scriptText: Professor: Previously, we discussed the significance of pottery to ancient cultures, including pottery as an art form and pottery's crucial role in trade. Today, we will focus on the development of pottery over time. One breakthrough was the invention of the potter's wheel around 3500 BCE in Mesopotamia. The potter's wheel allowed artisans to spin and shape clay more quickly and evenly. Updraft kilns helped potters control oxygen during firing, which affected the final color of the pottery. Later, very high-temperature kilns allowed potters to create stoneware and eventually porcelain, a smooth white ceramic fired above 1,200 degrees Celsius.

correctAnswer: The technological development of pottery.
